region_scene_page.compact: A 1960s songcraft lane where folk lyric weight, electric band sound, and vocal harmony become pop-rock language.
region_scene_page.standard: Folk-rock begins when folk songs and topical writing meet drums, electric guitars, and pop radio. Dylan, The Byrds, Simon & Garfunkel, Buffalo Springfield, and The Mamas & the Papas each balance seriousness and accessibility differently. This lane is more lyric-centered than jangle pop alone and less studio-fantastical than psychedelic pop. The words and vocal blend carry as much weight as the guitars.
